title: Length Bound for the Split Encoding
statement: Let $C,c$ be natural numbers and let $y$ be a finite binary string. The word emitted by the exponential split procedure on $y$ has length at most $2|y|+2$.
replaced: For all natural numbers $C, c$ and every binary string $y$, the word emitted by the exponential split emitter on $y$ has length at most $2|y| + 2$.
